method: Persisted request starts, response/error elapsed_s, outer ExecResult.duration_ms; never filesystem mtime. Residual is not active execution or measured pause. Format failures are a subset of calls, not extra time. Host checks on legacy runs are readable-oracle checks, not private proof.
